seo.title: Your Company — theatre and concert hall in Tashkent
seo.description: What’s on at Your Company theatre in Tashkent: drama, chamber concerts and children’s matinees. A 320-seat hall, tickets from 80,000 sum, box office and online booking.
seo.answer: Your Company is a theatre and concert venue at 12 Mustaqillik Street in Tashkent. A 320-seat hall with performances Tuesday to Sunday at 19:00 and weekend matinees at 11:00. Tickets run from 80,000 sum in the balcony to 250,000 sum in the stalls; the box office is open 11:00–21:00 and you can book by phone or Telegram.

sections.title: Your Company
sections.subtitle: Drama, chamber music and fairy tales for children in a 320-seat hall where the stage can see every face.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A stage without a fourth wall
sections.text: We perform in a former House of Culture restored in 2016: a wooden hall, living acoustics and an orchestra pit for a chamber ensemble. The company has twenty actors, and on weekend mornings the stage belongs to children.

items.title: Hamlet
items.text: The season premiere: three hours, one interval, in Pasternak’s translation.

items.title: The Cherry Orchard
items.text: In the repertoire for five years, now with a new cast.

items.title: An evening of Shashmaqom
items.text: A chamber ensemble performing the classical music of Bukhara and Khorezm.

items.title: The Little Prince
items.text: A matinee with puppets and live music, 60 minutes.

items.title: The Government Inspector
items.text: Gogol transposed into a modern city.

items.name: Balcony
features: A full view of the stage from above

items.name: Dress circle
features: The best sound in the house

items.quote: We sat in the dress circle and heard every whisper. I have seen The Cherry Orchard twice now.
items.author: Gulnora

items.quote: We took our son to The Little Prince and he drew the sheep in the box for a week afterwards.
items.author: Anvar

items.a: Evening shows at 19:00, matinees at 11:00 on weekends. Doors open 45 minutes before.
After the third bell latecomers are seated at the interval — the actors ask us to.
No. Come as you are comfortable.

items.q: From what age can children come?
items.a: Matinees from age 4, evening shows from 12 unless stated otherwise.

sections.label: Box office
sections.title: See you in the hall
sections.text: The box office is open Tuesday to Sunday, 11:00–21:00. We hold bookings for 24 hours; pay by card or cash.
